spanish: Y tejerás a cuadros la túnica de lino fino, y harás turbante de lino fino, y cinto harás obra de bordador.

findings.issue: Túnica and turbante stand in absolute juxtaposition with shesh; Spanish de adds a genitive link those absolute tokens do not encode.

notes: Piel 2ms, both qal 2ms make-verbs, singulars, and repeated 8336 b are otherwise matched.
